_doc: Feed list for seed_miners research_feeds. Add a ground by adding a row; nothing is hard-coded in the miner. Every feed here is a published RSS/Atom endpoint meant for machines. A dead URL shows as a fetch_error row and in seed_miners_state.json rf_status, never as silence. `verified` records whether a session saw a 200 from it; the cloud container that wrote this list cannot reach these hosts, so the first box pass is the measurement. A feed is fetched only when `terms` is "open"; anything else stays CLOSED and is reported as closed in rf_status. Record a terms verdict with its evidence before opening one.
